title: Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, 710ml, Denim
features: Our 710 ml insulated stainless-steel water bottle, showcasing the innovative FreeSip spout and a push-button lid complete with a reliable lock. Experience the epitome of sipping liberation with every refreshing sip!

Unleash the power of our patented FreeSip spout, meticulously designed for the best of both worlds. Sip with finesse through the built-in straw or indulge in a bold swig by tilting back—your beverage, your rules.

Our protective push-to-open lid ensures your spout stays pristine, guaranteeing a clean and refreshing sip every time. The convenient carry loop isn't just for style; it doubles as a lock, ensuring your drink stays secure on the move.

Embrace the chill with double-wall insulation that keeps your drinks refreshingly cold for a remarkable 24 hours. The wide opening is great for cleaning and adding ice while the cup holder-friendly base adds practicality to every sip.
Our Bottles are Lead, BPA and phthalate-free. Hand wash the cup with ease, while the dishwasher-safe lid adds a touch of convenience. Please note, this bottle is not suitable for hot liquids.
